Appendix (Military Service Act Enforcement Rules) <No. 907, 2016.11.29>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This rule shall take effect from November 30, 2016.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Regulations) Items ① to ⑩ are omitted.

⑪ The Enforcement Rules for the "Student Military Training Implementation Decree" are amended as follows:

Item 1 and 2 of Article 2 are changed to "Student Officer Candidate Training Program" respectively.

Item 3 of Article 3 is changed to "Student Officer Candidate Military Training."

Items other than 1 of Article 7, Item 1 of Article 9 are changed to "Student Officer Candidate Training Program."
